Web development

MindScape .

User flows and a relational database for a health education website with personal profiles and community forums.

View Project Folder

Project context

Web Design & Development · Team of four

  • PHP · Yii2
  • MySQL
  • Bootstrap

User needs

MindScape brings health profiles, a BMI calculator, reflection questionnaires, articles, and group discussions into one website. Members can save results and revisit their questionnaire history from their accounts.

My contribution

I worked on the HTML, user flows, database design, entity–relationship diagram, and Yii implementation. I mapped accounts, health records, and forum membership to the application’s models, views, and controllers.

Implementation

The database design spans 11 tables. The Yii2 application uses MySQL for storage and Bootstrap for the interface. PHP connects the Scapy chatbot to Gemini. The questionnaires and BMI calculator serve an educational purpose.
